# distillers reference

distillers is an offline Python document-distillation engine. The stdlib core parses fixed web-text-mirror banners, extracts source-anchored units, renders Markdown and JSON, and deduplicates text. Optional ollama-client supplies embeddings.

Version: 0.1.1. Python >=3.11. [src: pyproject.toml]

Commands: bulk, render, diff, merge, index, novelty, fetch, clean, extract, mirror. [src: distill_offline.py]

OLLAMA_HOST defaults to http://localhost:11434; OLLAMA_HOSTS configures the pool; DISTILL_EMBED_MODEL defaults to mxbai-embed-large. [src: distill_offline.py]

Use --no-semantic for a bulk run without embedding requests. index requires working embeddings. [src: distill_offline.py]

Mirror extraction, bulk cache/master, vector entries and novelty matches retain source_anchor provenance. [src: distill_offline.py]

Bulk cache reuse validates input content and configuration. Changed inputs rebuild the cache. [src: distill_offline.py]

Frozen corpus helpers have import-time writes. Never import them in routine tooling. [src: CLAUDE.md]

Read docs/wiki/README.md for commands, procedures and strategy. [src: docs/wiki/README.md]
